text: So you can tell what each new thing does, add them one at a time, starting with the UMP trial and working down the list below to the keto diet. 5-HTP could help your mood here, though iboga acts on serotonin too, so don't take 5-HTP at all while you're microdosing iboga or elliptica. There isn't enough data to say you should or shouldn't use UMP with any microdose, nor whether 5-HTP would be good with a mushroom microdose, so try those combos if you want and see how it feels. Mushrooms act on serotonin too, just not the way iboga does, so stop the 5-HTP if you get any of the stop signs the 5-HTP section lists. If you're too numb to tell how a combo feels, compare your sleep and dreams on the nights after a microdose day and a day without.
